title: FS-4471 Flow sensor datasheet
text: The FS-4471 flow sensor measures water velocity in pipes up to eighty millimetres. Firmware v2.3.1 adds a low-flow alarm. Ships in boxes of 2,400 units.

title: FS-4472 Pressure sensor datasheet

title: Cold start procedure
text:
Before a cold start, check that every pump is primed and that the pressure relief valve is closed. Open the inlet slowly so the pipework fills without hammering.

Start the duty pump first. Watch the pressure gauge until it settles, then start the standby pump and confirm both are sharing the load.

If the pressure does not settle within ten minutes, stop both pumps and call the duty engineer.

title: Warm restart
text: A warm restart keeps the pumps primed. Start is quicker because the pipework is already full, and the cold valve stays closed.

title: Glazing handbook
text: Mix each glaze by weight, sieve it twice and test it on a tile before a full firing. Record every recipe in the studio book.

title: Calibration routine
text: Calibrate each gauge against the reference rig every quarter and file the certificate. Ilse Warrender signs every certificate.
